quotes.text: The <var>none</var> mode ignores the provided filters and selects only messages without any tags.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The public none mode maps to internal NONE. That branch adds a Keywords IsEmpty term and returns before selected-tag inclusion/exclusion logic, selecting messages without any tags rather than messages that merely lack chosen tags. The public schema explicitly says supplied filters are ignored. The new extension fixture uses an empty criteria map, so that case does not directly assert ignoring a conflicting nonempty map. No search was run.
title: Untagged-only quick filtering bypasses selected tag criteria
